name: c409_14_gc_remove_moved
covers: GC remove, commit key moved: a writer's commit lands after the pass has listed and before its batch; the batch carries the commit key the pass read, so it conflicts and deletes nothing, and the pass starts again from a fresh read of the commit key and deletes only what the new commit does not name

labels.A: begin ordinary commit; A: upload u; A: a: open, commit: the eleven unit uploads
labels.GC: begin pass; GC: list keys; GC: read: gc: read commit key (R), mark, read fence, then list, held until a's uploads are applied: the eleven new units and the three garbage units are candidates
labels.A: commit CAS ok -> v2: a: the commit-key write, held until the list is applied
labels.GC: remove [m/A1.1.g1,u/A1.0.g0] (check-: gc: retireChecked of the fourteen candidates, held until a's commit is applied, conflicts on the commit key; the second round re-reads, marks from the new commit key and deletes the three garbage units
